items.reason: The header prints before the status table with the Task set, Runtime path, and binding kind.
Header output has no condition based on the invocation directory.
Directory comparison controls the “invoked from” line and resolves symlinks.
The routing result carries the Default binding flag into the header.
The old “draining at bound checkout” output is removed.
Single-task runs print the current checkout path without a Drain header.
Completed tasks print one green “done” result line.
Both commit SHA and verified no-op details print below the result line.
Whole-set runs no longer call the old completion summary; each ending has one result line.
Exhausted task failures print one red “failed” line and retain Failed status.
Provider exhaustion prints one red “out of agents (left open)” line and preserves Open status.
Quota pauses print the yellow result line with the preset before recovery waits.
Interrupted execution errors select the yellow “interrupted” result line.
Blocked and Deferred remain set-level reports; executed tasks retain their result lines.
Attempt failure output, attempt breakdowns, and exhausted-walk output remain.
The existing output layer prints complete lines without ANSI sequences for redirected output.
Terminal output uses styles, and NO_COLOR disables them.
The new rendering functions write output only and add no Work journal rows.

scores.rationale: Clear structure and useful tests, but single-task quota pauses now incorrectly print “Completed”; interruption and Deferred integration coverage is incomplete.
